profileName: Enterprise Legal Identity, Registration and Presence

cases.input: A second register extract arrives for a possible existing organization.
cases.expect: A new unlinked registration record is created; no subject is minted or merged automatically.

cases.input: One subject has home-register, LEI and VAT records.
cases.expect: Qualified records retain independent schemes, validity and statuses.

cases.input: A branch lacks separate legal personality but has local registration and presence.
cases.expect: The branch subject, head office, registration and presence are explicitly related without making the branch obligor.

cases.input: Equal strings from different identifier schemes are treated as the same organization.
A physical outlet is treated as proof of legal personality.
